summary: ABDM Scan & Share (facility side) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (QR endpoint + RBAC, shares list scoping/RBAC, inbound gateway JWT 401, processing harness). Supabase hospital_patients create + match (abha number/address and phone+name) verified directly; abha_records row created with owner=hospital uid and last_verified_via 'scan_share (ABDM app)'; token reuse + share_count increment + per-day sequence + expiry to IST midnight verified. Frontend: hospital /abha shows card above tabs with QR, counter code, print poster popup, date picker max=today, refresh, count, rows/tokens, empty state for past date; master admin sees card without QR and with Hospital column. One minor frontend bug: poster QR is not enlarged.

minor.issue: Race: the 'prev' lookup and the seq $inc are not atomic, so two near-simultaneous shares from the same ABHA (e.g. ABDM retry/double tap) can each get a new token number. One of them is then lost by the upsert. Fix: claim the token atomically, e.g. a unique index on (counter, abha_address, date) plus insert-or-get.

On a match, abha_kyc is fully overwritten with the new share payload, and abha_address is overwritten as well. If the patient has a different ABHA address or the share is partial, earlier KYC fields are lost. Not a bug for the main flow.

ui_bugs.issue: The poster QR stays at 168px instead of 320px. The code calls innerHTML.replace('width="168" height="168"', ...), but qrcode.react renders attributes in the order height="168" width="168", so the replace never matches. Fix: replace each attribute separately (or set both with a regex), or render a separate <QRCodeSVG size={320}> for printing.

issues: The Hospital column shows 'Test Admin' for the test hospital. hospital_name falls back to the user's name because there is no hospital_profiles row. This comes from the data, but it can be confusing.

action_items: Fix the print poster QR resize (attribute-order mismatch in the replace)
Optional: make token assignment atomic per (counter, abha_address, date)
critical_code_review_comments: Token prev-check and seq increment are not atomic (minor race)
The hospital_patients 'age' column is derived only from yearOfBirth (fine)
